title: Mandelson tried to set up meeting between Trump adviser and lobbying firm he held shares in
summary: Then ambassador to US wanted to discuss alternatives to World Trade Organization in ‘under the radar’ meeting, documents reveal
byline: Henry Dyer, Pippa Crerar and Paul Lewis

blocks.text:
Then ambassador to US wanted to discuss alternatives to World Trade Organization in ‘under the radar’ meeting, documents reveal

  • UK politics live – latest updates

Peter Mandelson sought to organise an “under the radar” meeting between an economic adviser to Donald Trump and a member of his former lobbying firm, Global Counsel, while he still held shares in the company, newly released documents reveal.

Mandelson’s attempt to organise the meeting followed a Foreign Office proposal of a “light touch way” to protect him “against perceptions of benefitting [Global Counsel] in some way while in public office”.
